metadata.datasource: Measured off Kodak Alaris F-4016 (rev. 6-18), KODAK PROFESSIONAL T-MAX 100 Film / 100TMX, D-76 developer, small tank, 6.5 min at 20 C (Kodak's time), interpolated between the published 6 and 7 1/2 minute curves along exposure at each density; diffuse visual density. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 100; base + fog 0.208. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: the D = 1.0 over D-min curve (equal-energy, erg/cm^2, effective exposure 1.4 s), which stops at 670 nm. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
